standard_power_hal.stock_table_gap: Hints 70, 71, 78 and 81 have no resources in the pinned stock table.
standard_power_hal.lineage_table: Generator adds exact stock touch resources for 70 and a candidate sustained profile for 78; 71 and 81 remain empty.
standard_power_hal.screen_off: libpowerhal perfUserScnDisableAll at 0x152f80 exempts screen-off states 1 and 3. Restore at 0x1531e0 changes the interactive flag; it does not eagerly replay all handles.
standard_power_hal.known_api_gap: Negative INTERACTION durations become an 80 ms boost. XML cannot repair this cancellation behavior.

configuration_ownership.client_1: PowerGenie frequency policy; used by the Lineage device service.
configuration_ownership.client_2: Thermal policy; must retain its independent handle.
configuration_ownership.translation: DoPerfSetConfig at 0x114c40 updates separate maps for clients 1 and 2 and emits the selected client map.
configuration_ownership.replacement: PerfServiceSetConfig at 0x115b20 releases the previous client handle before acquiring a new duration-0 handle and caching its result.
configuration_ownership.release: DoSetconfigReleaseHandle at 0x115e40 looks up that client, releases a positive handle and clears its cache entry.
configuration_ownership.cache: DoSetconfigCacheHandle at 0x116020 stores the new handle under that client.
configuration_ownership.warning: A successful Binder transaction or an aggregate ceiling read does not prove that a specific client vote has been removed.

frequency_units.meaning: Middle CPU minimum/maximum on the three-cluster path
Prime CPU minimum/maximum on the three-cluster path

frequency_units.unit: Performance-level index, not Hz or kHz

gpu_rules.initialize: InitDefaultValue at 0x1106e0 sets default maximum index 0 and minimum index querySysInfo(5,0)-1.
gpu_rules.maximum: UpdateMaxGpuFreq at 0x114ae0 accepts 0..defaultMinimumIndex; negative or larger inputs select default maximum index 0.
gpu_rules.minimum: UpdateMinGpuFreq at 0x114ab0 constrains the minimum index relative to the maximum and available range.
gpu_rules.conflict: For a valid maximum index greater than the current minimum index, initialization state 1 also moves that minimum index to the maximum.
gpu_rules.evidence_limit: No current GPU level-count or runtime readback was queried for this audit.

backend.count: 0x15a920 reads /sys/kernel/ged/hal/total_gpu_freq_level_count; capability query 5 at 0x1549a0 returns the cached count.
backend.initialize: 0x17ffa0 checks driver support; minimum indices become count-1 and maximum votes -1.
backend.arbitration: Soft and hard votes are combined before driver writes. Releasing a soft ceiling preserves an independent hard ceiling.
backend.api_boundary: UniPerf invalid maximum indices select default 0. Raw MTK callback out-of-range handling differs; do not interchange these APIs.
backend.validation: tests/emulate_stock_gpu.py executes pinned ARM64 callbacks with intercepted driver calls: 14 cases, synthetic 20-level fixture, no hardware calibration.

uniperf.getter: DoPerfGetConfig at 0x116100 reads nodes for frequency tags and returns cached defaults for tags 43..50. Its final return value can be success without establishing valid output for every tag.

scheduler_level.server: Any tag 55 or 56 routes the entire configuration batch to SchedLevelManager.
scheduler_level.tag_55: A single value 0 resets to defaults, 1 steps down and 2 steps up.
scheduler_level.tag_56: Explicit level values use a separate validated path; do not mix ordinary frequency tags into this batch.
scheduler_level.adapter: DoSchedLevelAction at 0x1166e0 is mov w0,wzr; ret. It performs no scheduler operation in this adapter.
scheduler_level.limitation: Successful scheduler-level bookkeeping is not proof of a scheduler change.

event_lifecycle.dispatch: EnterActionProc at 0x1154c0 parses configuration and payload before selecting immediate, long-term or deferred actions.
event_lifecycle.duration: DoAction at 0x1176e0 routes duration 0 to DoLongTermAction (0x117ca0), positive durations to the platform action, and negative durations to no action.
event_lifecycle.timer: NewPerfRequest at 0x117440 copies the action and payload, creates a request timer, and arms SetTimer at 0x126440 in milliseconds.
event_lifecycle.callback: RequestTimerCallback at 0x125e50 dispatches DoCallbackAction, deletes the timer and disposes of its temporary action. It has a latest-request guard for window-switch cancellation.
event_lifecycle.event_handles: PerfServiceEvent at 0x112ff0 reuses and caches event handles for selected command/payload combinations; other requests use a new handle.
event_lifecycle.touch_up: DoTouchUpRelease at 0x113540 checks list-fling and slide-normal handles before allowing touch cancellation.
event_lifecycle.no_blanket_cleanup: ClearAllCacheHandle at 0x116c00 is a bare ret. It is not a global release mechanism.
event_lifecycle.remaining: Exact cancellation and replacement behavior must be qualified per event and caller; these mechanisms do not establish that an arbitrary event is suitable for a new framework hook.
event_lifecycle.native_resource_cleanup: libpowerhal perfScnUpdate 0x150b70 arbitrates active votes and invokes registry +0x38 with the default on final release; one-shot controls have separate unset and replay paths. Registry +0x30/+0x38 are apply/release callbacks, not min/max controls.

cpu_backend.arbitration: 0x14ed00 updates cluster soft/hard votes; 0x14f510 combines per-core and cluster votes, clamps hardware ranges and applies hard constraints.

driver_write.format: CPU minimum_kHz maximum_kHz followed by a space

cpu_backend.ownership: Retain native vote arbitration; do not write this proc node from the framework.

event_selection.scene: Scene-specific lookup uses command_id*1000+scene for scene<1000; replacement requires an existing action with positive duration.
event_selection.scene_payload: 0x114c50 parses pid/tid/sceneId/special_sceneId/pkg; single payload 0 starts, -1 ends. Special scene 100..999 overrides the general scene.
event_selection.state_payload: 0x114e10 maintains validated state bits and forwards derived state to the platform.
event_selection.duration_override: OnDemandBoostServer::GetDuration at 0x104290 in libiawareperfpolicy_server.so can extend event 4098 and conditionally 4099; it does not shorten the original duration.

xml_translation.unknown_field: Rejects the action. Command 4271 contains unregistered vip_prefer_idle/graphic_prefer_idle and is not a usable benchmark boost.
xml_translation.metadata: CPU topology and frequency-level commands configure the parser. Duration, boost_limit_level and off-delay fields have special handling.
xml_translation.absent_commands_meaning: These IDs occur in examined Java callers but have no action in the pinned table; emitting them alone does not establish a hardware effect.

interactive_notification.native: DoNotificationEvent 0x115130 updates UniPerfServer+0x10 for a single integer payload. UniPerfEvent 0x1141a0 uses this state to reject selected start/launch boosts while the screen is off unless canBoost overrides it.
interactive_notification.wire: V1 NDK interface: Bp 0x1089f0, dispatcher 0x108440; transaction1, command int32, string, int32 array, one-way.
interactive_notification.lineage: DevicePowerService supplies observed interactive state through PowerController. Repeated states are deduplicated; failed delivery has three delayed retries, fenced by screen generation; HAL death invalidates the cache.
interactive_notification.initialization: Release before observers are ready does not invent a screen state.
interactive_notification.limit: One-way delivery is not a native completion acknowledgement.

controls.0x1071a0: uclamp_task uses sched_setattr syscall 274, a 56-byte attribute and a minimum clamped to 0..1024.
controls.0x105fd0: cpuPolicyThread creates its own SfCpu worker with SCHED_FIFO priority 2 and waits on a condition variable when its queue is empty.
controls.0x107e70: changeToSystem applies SFMainPolicy to SF, RenderEngine, worker and cached HWC thread IDs when the mask-only path is disabled.
controls.0x1080b0: changeToSystemMask applies a default or configured CPU affinity mask.
controls.0x1081c0: initForeground applies task profiles and affinity to the same thread groups when mask mode is enabled.
controls.0x108640: resetPerf resets the calculated performance indices. It is not a general task-attribute restore.
controls.0x10a270: Destructor stops and joins the worker, closes its descriptor and frees state. It does not restore every surviving external thread attribute.

surfaceflinger_scheduling.owner: The stock CpuAdapter is process-scoped; compositor Binder reconnection is not a policy-destruction boundary.
surfaceflinger_scheduling.lineage: SfCpuPolicyBridge retains this native plugin and its process lifetime, supplies real frame observations and forwards HWC thread IDs.
surfaceflinger_scheduling.remaining: Physical scheduling effect, thread turnover and performance/battery impact remain unmeasured in this offline audit.

stock_callers.behavior: Reflection invokes uniPerfSetConfig with client 1 and tag/value arrays; result 0 is accepted.
Selects scene policies, handles multi-window/game exceptions, clamps limits to discovered ranges and applies changed CPU/GPU values.
Maps relative scheduler-level changes to tag 55; zero resets, negative steps use 1, positive steps use 2.
Requests scheduler reset through l.W(0); success is bookkeeping, not proof of native action.
Sends event 4102 start payload 0 and cancellation -1 during a proprietary wake-readiness flow. Not evidence for a generic screen-on broadcast boost.

present: Stock frequency policy installed for retained Uniperf service
Battery Saver GPU ceiling 10 awake / 12 asleep, gated on readable driver level count; missing or insufficient capability releases GPU vote
Stock UniPerf interactive-state notification 20226 with bounded retries, stale callback fencing and replay after service death
lineage_comparison.fixed_in_this_audit: Release transport failures now receive at most three delayed retries; stale retries cannot replace a newer policy, and failed releases are not permanently suppressed.
not_implemented: Stock application classification and per-app scene selection
lineage_comparison.qualification: CPU observations do not verify GPU application. Driver access, performance and battery effects require the later combined hardware test; full stock app-scene parity is not claimed.

powergenie_selection.mode_transition: PolicyService cancels the old mode event (-1), updates mode and notifies policy consumers, then starts the new event (0). Event 4126 is absent from the native table.
powergenie_selection.scene_loading: resgovernor.f.k at DEX 0x1762e4 rebuilds the scene map from PolicyProvider rows for the selected power_mode.
powergenie_selection.classification: CpuGovernor.e at 0x177528 dispatches mode changes and scene events; f.n at 0x17524c selects app/activity and parent-scene policies, including restore on scene end.
powergenie_selection.delays: f.g at 0x176a28 and f.f at 0x176b30 select explicit and event-dependent delays; t.n at 0x17a1f0 coalesces pending message 100 before applying a changed policy.
powergenie_selection.apply: t.D at 0x17b668 applies CPU/GPU/DDR limits and scheduler requests after multi-window/game exceptions and policy merging.
powergenie_selection.command_replacement: ScalingFreqAdapter.l.b0 cancels the previous configured command with -1 before starting its replacement with 0; -1 alone cancels the stored command.
powergenie_selection.cleanup_limit: A null selected policy clears Java/helper state but is not proof that every native handle was released.
powergenie_selection.port_limit: The Lineage Battery Saver bridge uses these default limits, not the full stock application classifier.
